name: Aeí

attributes.attribute: place of a great bull battle

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The plain of Aeí is a place in Irish myth. In the great epic the Tain Bo Cuailnge, the two great bulls of the cattle raid of Connacht against Ulster fight their last battle on this plain. They were reborn men who had to fight again across each lifetime. They fought for three days and three nights, until both lay dead. Writers have set the plain of Aeí in many parts of the Irish landscape.

okr.objective: Put the plain of Aeí and its great battle on record.
key_results: Give the plain of Aeí its place in the epic.
Tell of the bulls and the three nights of battle.
